links.comparator_used: Simple prompt without structured diagnostic guidance
links.outcome: Recall and F1-score for zero-shot IFE image classification across ten classes
links.effect: Detailed prompting consistently improved recall and F1-scores; no per-class simple vs detailed deltas given in the abstract. Gemini with detailed prompts reached F1 of MK 89.80, AK 84.75, GK 71.54.
links.quote: Detailed prompting consistently improved recall and F1-scores, underscoring the importance of prompt design.
